title: Flashback
shortDescription: Flashback is organized in GameAtlas's Super Nintendo Entertainment System action and platformer and puzzle collection with a source-linked record and deterministic catalog context.
highlights: Makes a documented action and platformer and puzzle option easier to find in the Super Nintendo Entertainment System path.
Pairs a frozen GameAtlas catalog method with a direct Wikidata structured-data record.
